title: Choose Pickle Spec's new visual world
question: Pick the world that should carry live and historical Test evidence across Studio.

options.label: Chain of Evidence
options.lineage: forensic case files, chain-of-custody forms, and photographic contact sheets
options.thesis: Every failure is a case whose causal chain can be proven instead of guessed.
options.viewport: A compact case index frames a causal timeline and a large evidence viewer for Checkout / Pay for the order / chrome.
options.risk: The paper language fails if it becomes decorative, nostalgic, or less dense than the evidence.

raised.raise: State changes never move controls; absent evidence occupies a deliberate fixed slot.
Dense measurements use strict tabular alignment without strobing or losing accessibility.
One causal graph drives the desktop evidence chain and the compact dependency diagram.
Every live phase is named, deep-linkable, and text-equivalent rather than color-only.
Failed, cancelled, and unavailable states mark themselves permanently instead of disappearing.

options.label: Flight Recorder Console
options.lineage: aviation flight-data recorders and incident investigation plots
options.thesis: The run is a synchronized signal record with one causal instant to isolate.
options.viewport: A multitrack event spine fills the center, with run instruments above and the selected screenshot and diagnostics locked at right.
options.risk: Its observability familiarity can become a generic monitoring dashboard without the Gherkin-to-action causal spine.

options.label: Test Bench Instrument
options.lineage: creator hardware, logic analyzers, and calibrated bench instruments
options.thesis: Test evidence behaves like a bench instrument: every signal has a labeled control and measurable state.
options.viewport: Timeline lanes occupy the instrument bed, the causal step owns the amber display, and artifacts slot into a dedicated inspection bay.
options.case: Wins both axes: QA operators recognize a test bench, and its control grammar makes state, filtering, and evidence actions explicit.
options.risk: Heavy skeuomorphism can slow scanning unless tactile detail stays subordinate to familiar controls.

options.label: Segment Matrix
options.thesis: Every state lights inside one immutable cell mask.
options.viewport: Fixed evidence cells illuminate as the Test run advances.
options.case: Loses clarity because a numeric display grammar cannot carry long Scenario evidence without becoming a costume.
options.kept: Fixed geometry through every state change.
options.risk: Long labels and diagnostics fight the segment alphabet.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.lineage: barcode fields and monochrome sine lattices
options.thesis: The run becomes a pure black-and-white field of measurable events.
options.viewport: Dense event columns pull one failed step into numerical focus.
options.case: Loses audience identification and accessibility because the severe abstraction hides ordinary QA affordances.
options.kept: Courageous information density and exact numerical alignment.
options.risk: Strobing and compressed labels work against WCAG and sustained investigation.

options.label: Causal Tension Graph
options.lineage: tensegrity structures and engineering force diagrams
options.thesis: A failure is the visible imbalance between action, state, and counter-evidence.
options.viewport: A causal network connects steps, diagnostics, and artifacts around the failed assertion.
options.case: Loses both axes when the network becomes more prominent than the familiar timeline and result controls.
options.kept: One state graph should drive both spatial and compact layouts.
options.risk: A literal force diagram adds cognitive load during urgent diagnosis.

options.label: Run Phases
options.lineage: theater cycloramas and inspectable lighting cues
options.thesis: The Test run moves through named atmospheric phases from idle to finished.
options.viewport: A scrubbable run horizon changes phase behind the selected result.
options.case: Loses clarity because broad color fields compete with semantic result states and dense evidence.
options.kept: Named, deep-linkable phases with reduced-motion equivalents.
options.risk: Atmosphere can outrank the task and make state color-dependent.

options.label: Run Coupon Book
options.lineage: jet-age ticket wallets and carbon-copy coupons
options.thesis: Each Scenario attempt is a coupon whose state remains stamped into the journey.
options.viewport: Attempt coupons stack beside a route-like run sequence and evidence stub.
options.case: Loses audience identification because a travel metaphor obscures Test result hierarchy.
options.kept: Nothing disappears; each terminal state stamps itself visibly.
options.risk: The coupon metaphor turns serious diagnostics into themed ephemera.

canonCard.label: Polished developer tool
canonCard.thesis: A conventional sidebar, summary cards, tabs, and data tables executed at a high craft level.
canonCard.viewport: Specification navigation at left, result summary above, and a familiar tabbed evidence table below.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable but indistinguishable from common CI and observability products.
